ga-county-commission-members.summary: The County card names your county and not the people on its board of commissioners, or its sole commissioner, and the map does not draw the districts they are elected from.
ga-county-commission-members.why: No state office publishes who sits on Georgia's county commissions. Each county's commissioners are elected on its own ballot, and this app has not yet named them from the state's election results or drawn the county maps.
ga-county-commission-members.wanted: Each county's own list of its commissioners and the district each one represents, with its current district map.

ga-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City or Town card names the place and says when a city and its county are one government, and not who your mayor and council are.
ga-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of Georgia's mayors and council members has been read for this app, and no city's own pages have been read yet.
ga-municipal-officeholders.wanted: A statewide roster of every city's and town's mayor and council members by district, or each place's own published list.

ga-school-board-members.summary: This app names your school district and not the people on its board, and does not draw the districts board members are elected from.
ga-school-board-members.why: No statewide list of Georgia's school board members has been read for this app. The boundary this card draws carries the district's name and nothing about its board.
ga-school-board-members.wanted: Each school system's own list of its board members and the district each one represents, with its current district map.
